These are the three places in the patient chart app that call `defineExtensionConfigSchema`. I found them with one text search of the checkout and did not open the files. I also did not search for re-exports or mocks of the function.

1. `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/index.ts` imports it at line 3. It calls it at line 25 for the `person-attribute-tag` extension.
2. `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/index.ts` imports it at line 1. It calls it at lines 21 and 22 for the `obs-by-encounter-widget` and `obs-table-horizontal-widget` extensions.
3. `packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/index.ts` imports it at line 1. It calls it at lines 12 and 13 for the `patient-flags-risk-count` and `patient-flags-list` extensions.
